stops.name: The Burn Engine
stops.line: This is the buy-and-burn engine, the heart of SMOKE.
aspects: This is the buy-and-burn engine, the heart of SMOKE. When holders convert their original SMOKE into OFT SMOKE, 90% of the original SMOKE goes straight to the burn contract. A burn removes tokens from circulation for good, so SMOKE works as culture plus a sink.
Think of the burn as a slow, steady fire. Every conversion feeds it, and whatever goes in never comes back out. Fewer tokens in circulation is the whole point of a sink.

SMOKE is a culture token first, which is why the sink is built in from day one. The community keeps the fire going just by using the token. That is the difference between a mascot coin and a mechanism.

stops.name: Stash From The Smoke Lounge
stops.line: Welcome to the Smoke Lounge, where SMOKE is paired with a basket of other assets in liquidity pools.
aspects: This stash comes straight from the Smoke Lounge, where SMOKE is paired with a basket of other assets in liquidity pools. When those pairs rise in value, the basket strengthens the buy and burn. So the more the lounge grows, the harder the burn engine can work.

The main pairs are SMOKE with X28 on BASE and Ethereum, and SMOKE with BNB on BSC. Steady liquidity lets people move in and out without wrecking the price. The pairing is what gives the lounge its weight.

The big liquidity positions on BASE and Ethereum are locked for ten years. That lock is a commitment, not a promise on a poster. A lounge you cannot walk away from with the furniture is a good lounge. The Lounge itself now hosts just the SMOKE NFT and the bong parties.

stops.name: The Omni-Chain Hub
stops.line: SMOKE lives on five chains: Solana, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum, BASE and BSC, bridged natively as one omni-chain token.
aspects: SMOKE lives on five chains: Solana, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum, BASE and BSC, bridged natively as one omni-chain token. Prices can drift between chains, and that gap is an arbitrage. The protocol captures that arb and recycles the value back into the ecosystem instead of ignoring it.
One token across every chain, with no wrapped copies to worry about. That is what omni-chain means here. Value moving between chains stays inside the family.
Recycled arb is why multi-chain supply is a strength. Every chain is another door into the same lounge. Value that gets captured comes back to work for holders.

plate.title: SMOKE
plate.subtitle: culture + sink
plate.design_notes: Circular ash-ring certificate hung on the archive wall behind Ember's desk, centred at eye level. Green desk lamp casts a soft cone from upper-left; neon rim adds a slow 3s glow pulse. Stamp hierarchy: 1) SMOKE title arc, 2) central Lounge-basket sink mark, 3) 'culture + sink' subtitle arc, 4) inward burn arrows as supporting motion. Plate bobs 2px on a 4s loop. No cigarette, no DEX UI, no QR, no numbers.

shapes: Outer ring: circle at 256,256 r240, rim stroke 10px, glow blur 18
Ash band: annulus r200-236, accent at 35% alpha, light speckle noise
Certificate edge: 48 small scallop arcs along r236, accent stroke 2px
Inner hairline ring: circle r196, rim stroke 1px at 50% alpha
Sink hole: circle r58 at centre, radial gradient #000000 to background
Basket mark in hole: bowl arc r40 lower half, rim stroke 4px
Basket weave: 4 vertical + 2 horizontal short lines in bowl, rim 2px
Basket rim: horizontal line across bowl top, rim stroke 4px
Burn arrows: 8 arrows at r185 pointing to centre, 45 deg apart, rim
Arrow tails: gradient from accent to transparent, extending outward
Title SMOKE: bold caps arced along top at r150, rim color with glow
Subtitle 'culture + sink': small caps arced along bottom r150, accent
Wisps: 3 faint bezier curves rising from hole, accent at 18% alpha
Vignette: radial darken outside r245 to canvas edge

stops.name: The BLAZE Forge
stops.line: This forge is where BLAZE meets DIAMONDS.
aspects: This forge is where BLAZE meets DIAMONDS. BLAZE sits on the Diamond mint path, so the flame feeds the supply. Follow the glow through the arch to see where it leads.
DIAMONDS was built to support BLAZE and X28 on Ethereum at the same time. The only liquidity pool is with X28. Keeping it simple keeps the forge honest.
A forge only burns while it has fuel, and BLAZE emissions end in waves. That is what makes every Diamond minted count. I will show you the scale next.

stops.name: The Scarcity Scale
stops.line: The waves end, and that is the whole point.
aspects: The waves end, and that is the whole point. Emission stops, sinks keep pulling Diamonds out, and the float stays tight. Fewer Diamonds around means each one carries more weight.
Scarcity here is designed, not hoped for. The mint path closes on a schedule, and staking absorbs what is left. Read the scale as supply against demand.
DIAMONDS pays rewards in ETH, which gives the token a real use besides selling. Three independent ETH payout pools share those rewards. A tight float keeps them meaningful.

stops.name: The Vault & Crush Press
stops.line: Stake your Diamonds in the Vault to earn shares and rewards.
aspects: Stake your Diamonds in the Vault to earn shares and rewards. The Crush Bonus lets you forfeit extra Diamonds in exchange for more shares. It is a trade: give up some Diamonds now for a bigger slice later.
The press is a commitment device. The more you are willing to put under it, the larger your share multiplier. It is always your choice and never automatic.

Sweeper bots capture ETH and send it to Diamond Certificate holders. Certificates are about ownership and access, including the 28-day payout pool, and we keep the detail high level here. The Vault is where patient holders live.

stops.name: The Handler Bridge
stops.line: Diamonds are required to mint GOLD, and this bridge carries them across.
aspects: Diamonds are required to mint GOLD, and this bridge carries them across. The Handler absorbs first-cycle mint-side Diamonds so the chart does not get dumped on. Think of it as a shock absorber between two protocols.

Every GOLD mint that uses Diamonds pulls demand toward this bridge. That ties DIAMONDS and GOLD MINE together instead of leaving them as two separate games. Walk it and you are travelling the ecosystem.
The Handler smooths the first cycle so no single day of minting can crash the price. That protects holders on both sides of the bridge. Stability is a feature.

stops.name: The Vesting Clock
stops.line: Mined GOLD does not arrive all at once.
aspects: Mined GOLD does not arrive all at once. It vests over about 100 days, roughly 1% a day. Claim early and you forfeit the part that has not vested yet.
Patience is the mechanism. Waiting out the full hundred days collects everything, and leaving early gives the remainder up. Vest, claim, then stake: those are the three moves that matter.
You can mine GOLD with ETH, or with ETH plus Diamonds. Either way the same vest clock starts ticking. One rule for everyone.

stops.name: The Fort Knox Window
stops.line: Through the glass is Fort Knox, where you stake GOLD to earn wBTC.
aspects: Through the glass is Fort Knox, where you stake GOLD to earn wBTC. Locks can run as long as 2,888 days, and longer locks weigh more in the share calculation. This room is a classroom, not the vault itself.

Fort Knox pays stakers in wBTC, and the same stake share also earns XAUT from the Gold Vein, so stakers get two payouts. One stake share decides both. The longer you commit, the more your shares count.
Sweeper bots capture XAUT and send it to two Gold Vein payout pools for Fort Knox stakers. XAUT is Tether Gold, backed by physical gold in Swiss vaults. That is a second stream on top of wBTC.

stops.name: The Melt Bonus Press
stops.line: The Melt Bonus lets you burn extra GOLD to boost your share multiplier.
aspects: The Melt Bonus lets you burn extra GOLD to boost your share multiplier. You can burn up to three times your staked amount. Combined with a maximum-term stake, the multiplier can reach up to 1,000%.
Burning is permanent, so the melt press is for people who believe in the long game. Every burn shrinks supply for everyone else. It is a bet on yourself and on scarcity.
Melt is optional and never automatic. You choose how much to feed the press and when. The stamp only records what you decided.

stops.name: The Gold Vein Board
stops.line: This board tracks the Gold Vein, where stakers earn a second payout.
aspects: This board tracks the Gold Vein, where stakers earn a second payout. Sweeper bots capture XAUT and send it to two payout pools for Fort Knox stakers. The same stake share that earns your wBTC also earns your XAUT.
There are no auctions to bid in anymore. Instead of competing, stakers simply earn: wBTC from Fort Knox and XAUT from the Gold Vein. Two payouts, one stake.
XAUT is Tether Gold, backed by physical gold in Swiss vaults. The sweeper bots keep collecting it and the Vein pays it out to stakers. Check the board to see how one share works twice.
